verdict.rationale: xAI documents data retention controls including a default 30-day retention and self-serve Zero Data Retention (ZDR) toggle per team, with a response header confirming ZDR status, which addresses data-persistence opt-out for API usage. However, this is about API request/output retention, not general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out (e.g., analytics, product telemetry, diagnostic data collection) for the consumer Grok product or SDK. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism (beyond data retention), documentation on what usage/analytics data is collected by default, and any consumer-facing (non-enterprise-team) telemetry opt-out.
